remarks: Step inside this charming ranch-style home tucked on a peaceful street in Norwalk and discover a surprisingly spacious layout full of character. With 3 bedrooms and 2 full baths across 1,196 square feet, this home balances cozy warmth with thoughtful design. The dining room welcomes you with exposed beams, a fireplace, and custom built-ins, flowing into an updated kitchen with granite counters, stainless steel appliances, and a sunny breakfast nook. The layout offers versatility, including a bedroom tucked quietly off the dining room and a generous living room anchoring the back of the home. Hardwood floors run throughout most rooms, enhancing the home's timeless appeal. Downstairs, a large waterproofed basement features a full bath, laundry, and bonus storage-ready for future finishing. Outside, a private garden oasis awaits, complete with a pergola for entertaining, and a 1-car garage adds convenience. Located moments from Route 1, I-95, and the Darien train station, you'll enjoy easy access to Norwalk's restaurants, beaches, and shopping. Beach rights included. This home blends personality, practicality, and location-ready for its next chapter.
